name: docs
description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK, IDR, RDD — standards, maker, review, validator, ten type templates, and file-bug (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, make-rubric), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (make-reference, make-llms-txt, make-vision-memo — knowledge-pack authoring lives in harness's make-pack), artifact/report-page authoring (make-artifact + artifact-rules — a design system's DESIGN.md/tokens.json (or a synthesized one, or a doctrine-neutral fallback) plus report, handbook, or project-records content into a rendered Artifact page; artifact-rules now carries procedure-side standards only, citing design's artifact-styling-rules for visual doctrine), project-facts (domain-knowledge harvest: discovered topic zones scored two-axis, Outside-In x Inside-Out) and its harness-facts sibling (the same harvest reframed for a coding agent's own harness: install-ready CLAUDE.md-grade entry-file sections, path-scoped rules, pack seeds, dispatch context, weighted Inside-Out x Outside-In), product-lifecycle-rules (the general, portable build-loop/alignment doc doctrine) and check-stage (its live lifecycle-position reading — which loop/build-turn stage a repo is in), and a fresh-context doc-checker agent alongside the experiment-runner agent.
